author: Warfnair
body:
You'll end up buying all trees eventually for skills.
Doesn't hurt to try different class, just bear in mind you'll need different gear and follower so it might feel underwhelming at 1st.

author: KevineCove
body: Beo is much more viable than Heretic but at T8 I would strongly consider giving Summoner a second chance, it will allow you to get to T10 faster even if you don't want to continue as a Summoner once you get there.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
I like Beo a *lot* more than Heretic. At lower levels, spell weaving works as a passive but not really at T10. I don't see many endgame Heretics at all. 


You can always swap back and forth freely, so yes I'd recommend trying it out. It's a fun class!

author: Sufficient_Piece3479
body: Buy them all. You can use skills from each class.

author: Mesona
body: I really like the play style of the Gilgamesh tree, but since hitting t10 the Valhallan tree is just so much easier. I have almost 10 ascendancy levels or whatever they're called in Gilgamesh and still deal so much more damage with a base Valhallan and spiritgarm.

author: PokeRunecrafter
body: I was a mage all the way until heretic 225. I could barely complete any content without massive problems, I actually switched to grand summoner and it has made t10 grinding/raiding/bosses/horde dungeons actually completable. I would highly recommend switching off mage until you have much better gear which is nearly impossible to farm early on.

author: troccolins
body: The specializations and classes you don't choose are generally better than the ones you do choose
